# HeatSafe Climate & Air Quality Intelligence Lab

> Open-source environmental intelligence and AI research for extreme heat,
> PM2.5, air quality, wildfire smoke, urban climate, forecasting,
> uncertainty and resilient homes.

- https://faramarzkowsari.github.io/heatsafe-climate-air-quality-lab/
